slides.title: 4 ways to tell a real cash buyer from a bad one
They close through a title company
slides.body: Your money moves through a licensed, neutral third party. Never directly through the buyer.

slides.title: They show you the numbers
slides.body: A real buyer explains how they got to the offer: repairs, comps, and costs.

slides.title: No upfront fees. No obligation.
slides.body: You should never pay anything to get an offer, and you can always say no.

slides.title: Proof of funds on request
slides.body: Ask for it. We provide it.

slides.title: That's how we do every deal.
slides.body: Cash offers on Florida houses in any condition.
